MiniOS Agent

Intent: TF-IDF features and logistic regression. Slots: a CRF tagger. Both were trained in Python and run here in plain JavaScript, on this phone, with no network calls. Dates, times and durations are read by a small rule-based parser, not by the model. Commands are simulated: the trace shows what would run on the Orange Pi, and system values are example figures. Timers and reminders do ring here while the page stays open.
